props.name: selected
props.about: Which accent colour is ringed as the chosen one. current follows the colour the panel uses now; the others pick that accent set by name.

props.name: state
props.about: How the swatches look: default can be tapped; disabled is dimmed and ignores taps; unavailable shows the colour cannot be read right now.

props.name: context
props.about: Where the swatches sit: alone on their own, or settings-row tucked into the right end of a row on a settings page.

props.name: sample
props.about: For previews only: which set of made-up agents to show. mixed has some needing you, calm has none needing you, empty has no agents at all.

props.name: value
props.about: How far round the arc is filled, from 0 (empty) to 100 (full).

props.name: size
props.about: How wide the arc is across, in pixels.

props.name: knob
props.about: Shows a round knob at the end of the filled part, the handle you drag on a dial.

props.name: state
props.about: default draws the arc in the accent colour; disabled greys it out to show it cannot be changed.

props.name: state
props.about: How the button looks: default ready to tap, pressed while a finger is on it, or disabled when there is nowhere to go back to.

props.name: values
props.about: The height of each bar, as numbers separated by commas, one bar per number from left to right.

props.name: colour
props.about: How the bars are coloured: bands colours each bar by its price band (cheap, normal, peak); series draws every bar in the one chart colour.

props.name: now
props.about: Which bar is now, counting from 0 on the left; it gets the dotted now marker. -1 shows no marker.

props.name: width
props.about: How wide the whole chart is, in pixels; 0 fills the space it is in.

props.name: height
props.about: How tall the tallest bar can be, in pixels.

props.name: scrub
props.about: Lets you press and drag along the chart to read the value of each bar.

props.name: ticks
props.about: Hour labels on the axis under the bars, every this many hours (6 = 00, 06, 12, 18); 0 shows none.

props.name: label
props.about: The small capitals line above the number that says what it is, such as today so far.

props.name: value
props.about: The number itself. It counts up to this value when the number first appears.

props.name: unit
props.about: The unit shown after the number, such as kWh or %. Leave empty for none.

props.name: decimals
props.about: How many digits are shown after the decimal point.

props.name: prefix
props.about: Text shown just before the number, such as a currency sign. Leave empty for none.

props.name: state
props.about: default shows the number; unavailable shows a dash in place of it when the value cannot be read.

props.name: sample
props.about: For previews only: which made-up collection week to show. tonight means put the bins out tonight, today means collection is today, collected means it is done, later means nothing soon, two means two bins go out together, none means no collections are known.

props.name: open
props.about: Whether the sheet is showing (open) or hidden off the bottom of the screen (closed). Changing it slides the sheet in or out.

props.name: list
props.about: For previews only: which made-up list fills the sheet, the speakers to play on or the light and dark theme choices.

props.name: title
props.about: The heading at the top of the sheet. Leave empty to use the list's own title.

props.name: selected
props.about: Which row is chosen, counting from 0 at the top; its radio is on.

props.name: screen
props.about: For previews only: draws a sample screen under the sheet so you can see it dim behind the scrim.

props.name: kind
props.about: How strong the button looks: primary is filled in the accent for the main action, secondary is a quieter fill, outline is just an edge, ghost is text only for the least important action.

props.name: label
props.about: The words on the button.

props.name: state
props.about: How the button looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, active when it is the chosen one, active-pressed while the chosen one is held, or disabled when it cannot be used.

props.name: icon
props.about: An icon shown before the words, or none for words only.

props.name: size
props.about: normal is the full button height; small is the smallest touch height with less padding, for an action inside a row such as a section header's See all.

props.name: width
props.about: hug fits the button to its words; fill stretches it across the space it is in, with the words centred.

props.name: view
props.about: Which view the calendar opens on: agenda lists the next event and the days after it; month shows six weeks of days with their events.

props.name: month
props.about: Which month the month view shows, written as year and month like 2026-10. Leave empty for this month.

props.name: name
props.about: The camera's name, shown along the bottom of the picture.

props.name: time
props.about: When the picture was taken, shown next to the name.

props.name: detect
props.about: What the camera saw, such as person or car, shown as a label on the box around it. Leave empty when nothing was seen.

props.name: score
props.about: How sure the camera is about what it saw, as a percentage.

props.name: box
props.about: Where the box around what was seen sits on the picture: left, top, width and height as percentages, separated by commas.

props.name: state
props.about: default shows the picture; unavailable shows that the camera cannot be reached.

props.name: size
props.about: tile is a small picture for a grid of cameras; full fills the screen with one camera.

props.name: entity
props.about: Which camera to show, by its Home Assistant entity id. Leave empty to use the sample picture.

props.name: label
props.about: The card's name, shown next to its icon at the top.

props.name: icon
props.about: The small icon before the name, or none.

props.name: preview
props.about: The small picture at the top right of the card, such as the weather now or the record that is playing, or none.

props.name: mode
props.about: What the middle of the card shows: value is a big short value such as 13°; text is a line of words such as the song playing.

props.name: value
props.about: The big value shown in the middle when the mode is value.

props.name: text
props.about: The words shown in the middle when the mode is text, such as a song title.

props.name: sub
props.about: The quieter supporting line at the bottom of the card.

props.name: tone
props.about: The colour of the supporting line: dim for normal, ok for good news, warn for something to watch, error for a problem.

props.name: accent
props.about: Edges the card in the accent colour to show it needs you now, such as a timer that is running.

props.name: state
props.about: How the card looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, or unavailable when its device cannot be reached.

props.name: press
props.about: How the card shows it is being pressed: fill darkens the whole card, border lights its edge, border-fill does both.

props.name: cells
props.about: The cards in order, separated by commas: s is a small square tile, three to a row; m is half the row; l is the full width; h is a read-only readout, two of which share one slot.

props.name: sample
props.about: For previews only: fills the cells with made-up cards so the layout can be seen.

props.name: preview
props.about: Which picture to draw, as it appears at the top right of a Home card: agents, media, a dial, a switch, the clock, a timer, GitHub, energy or lightning.

props.name: value
props.about: The level the picture shows where it has one, such as how far round the dial is, from 0 to 100.

props.name: on
props.about: Whether the thing the picture stands for is on, such as the switch or the dial's light.

props.name: unavailable
props.about: Shows the picture greyed out, for a device that cannot be reached.

props.name: quiet
props.about: For the lightning picture: shows a quiet sky with no recent strikes.

props.name: cells
props.about: The cells in order, separated by commas: c holds one component; p holds two half-height readouts, one above the other.

props.name: min-w
props.about: The narrowest a cell gets: tile-w for tiles (three to a row), home-card-min-w for Home cards (two to a row).

props.name: min-h
props.about: The shortest a cell gets: tile-h for tiles, card-h for Home cards.

props.name: last
props.about: A short last row: column keeps its cells the width of the rows above; fill lets them share the whole row (a lone Home card goes full width).

props.name: wide
props.about: Every cell on its own row, the full width: a wide card.

props.name: sample
props.about: For previews only: fills the cells with cards so the layout can be seen.

props.name: check
props.about: Where the item is: open not started, doing in progress with an accent dot, or done filled with a check mark.

props.name: label
props.about: The words next to the box.

props.name: interactive
props.about: Lets a tap move the box between open and done. Off makes it read-only.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be used; disabled is greyed out and ignores taps.

props.name: name
props.about: The name of the check, such as test or build.

props.name: state
props.about: How the check went: pass, fail, pending while it still runs, or skipped. The dot and the word change to match.

props.name: width
props.about: How wide the row is, in pixels.

props.name: face
props.about: Which clock to draw: hero is big digits, ring adds a dotted ring with a seconds dot going round, analogue has thin hands, compact is the small time in a header, orbit circles the time with the date.

props.name: font
props.about: The typeface of the digits: mono is the fixed-width face, inter the rounder everyday face.

props.name: format
props.about: 24h shows 13:00; 12h shows 1:00 with AM or PM.

props.name: date
props.about: How the date under the time is written: short like MON 19 OCT, or long like Monday 19 October.

props.name: seconds
props.about: Shows the seconds as well as hours and minutes.

props.name: time
props.about: For previews only: a fixed time to show, like 14:52:20. Leave empty for the real time.

props.name: day
props.about: For previews only: a fixed date to show, like 2026-10-19. Leave empty for today.

props.name: condition
props.about: The weather now, shown beside the time on faces that have room, such as partly-day. Leave empty for none.

props.name: temp
props.about: The temperature now, shown with the weather. Leave empty for none.

props.name: outline
props.about: For previews only: outlines the top and foot areas so you can see where the content and the buttons go.

props.name: on
props.about: What the marks sit on: box for a card or tile, button for a smaller button.

props.name: corners
props.about: Which corners get a mark: all four, or tr-bl for just top right and bottom left.

props.name: state
props.about: active shows the marks; active-pressed shows them while the active control is held; default hides them.

props.name: count
props.about: The number in the badge. Above 99 it shows 99+.

props.name: tone
props.about: The badge colour, by what the number means: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

props.name: zero
props.about: What happens at zero: muted shows a quiet 0; hide removes the badge.

props.name: kind
props.about: What hangs in the window: a roller blind, a Venetian blind with slats, or curtains.

props.name: position
props.about: How open the cover is, from 0 (closed) to 100 (fully open).

props.name: tilt
props.about: For Venetian blinds: how far the slats are turned, from 0 (shut) to 100 (fully open).

props.name: device_class
props.about: The kind of cover as Home Assistant names it, such as curtain or blind. When set it picks the drawing: curtain draws curtains, a cover that tilts draws a Venetian blind, anything else a roller blind.

props.name: cover
props.about: The cover this screen controls, by its Home Assistant entity id.

props.name: covers
props.about: Every cover you can switch between on this screen, as entity ids separated by commas.

props.name: state
props.about: What the cover is doing: open, closed, opening, closing, or unavailable when it cannot be reached.

props.name: kind
props.about: What hangs in the window: a roller blind, a Venetian blind with slats, or a pair of curtains.

props.name: position
props.about: How open the cover is, from 0 (closed) to 100 (fully open).

props.name: tilt
props.about: For Venetian blinds: how far the slats are turned, from 0 (shut) to 100 (fully open).

props.name: heading
props.about: Where the cover is moving to while it moves, from 0 to 100, shown as a faint target. -1 means it is not moving.

props.name: draggable
props.about: Lets you drag the blind's edge, or the curtains sideways, to move the cover.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be dragged; disabled cannot be moved; unavailable shows the cover cannot be reached.

props.name: style
props.about: short is compact capitals like MON 19 OCT; long is written out like Monday 19 October.

props.name: date
props.about: For previews only: a fixed date like 2026-10-19. Leave empty for today.

props.name: value
props.about: The value the dial is set to, between its lowest and highest.

props.name: min
props.about: The lowest value the dial goes down to.

props.name: max
props.about: The highest value the dial goes up to.

props.name: on
props.about: Whether the thing it controls is on. Off dims the dial; the button in the middle switches it.

props.name: caption
props.about: The word under the value that says what it is, such as Brightness.

props.name: unit
props.about: The unit shown after the value, such as % or °.

props.name: step
props.about: How much one step of the dial changes the value.

props.name: dimmable
props.about: Whether the value can be set. Off = an on/off light or a switch: the ring shows on or off, only the button in the middle works.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be turned; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the device cannot be reached; missing shows there is no such device.

props.name: a
props.about: The size of the first part of the ring.

props.name: b
props.about: The size of the second part of the ring.

props.name: c
props.about: The size of the third part of the ring.

props.name: size
props.about: How wide the ring is across, in pixels.

props.name: icon
props.about: The icon at the top: done for all clear, alert for a problem, pr for pull requests.

props.name: title
props.about: The short heading that says nothing is here.

props.name: body
props.about: One quieter line under the heading that explains it.

props.name: tone
props.about: The icon's colour, by what the emptiness means: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

props.name: icon
props.about: The icon on the tile, picked for the kind of thing it is, such as a bulb for a light or a door for a door sensor.

props.name: label
props.about: The thing's name on the tile.

props.name: status
props.about: The short state under the name, such as 64% or Off.

props.name: on
props.about: Whether the thing is on. On tiles are lit in the accent colour.

props.name: act
props.about: What a tap does: toggle switches it on or off, open opens its own screen, none does nothing.

props.name: state
props.about: How the tile looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, or unavailable when the device cannot be reached.

props.name: press
props.about: How the tile shows it is being pressed: fill darkens the whole tile, border lights its edge, border-fill does both.

props.name: event
props.about: What happened, as time, action and who did it separated by bars, like 09:03|locked|Alex. A jammed lock shows in the error colour.

props.name: marker
props.about: How the car is drawn: a plain dot, the driver's three-letter code, or the car number.

props.name: code
props.about: The driver's three-letter code, such as NOR.

props.name: num
props.about: The car's racing number.

props.name: colour
props.about: The team colour, as a hex colour like #F47600.

props.name: lead
props.about: Marks the car as the race leader.

props.name: label
props.about: Shows the driver's code in a tag beside the car.

props.name: pit
props.about: Shows the car is in the pit lane.

props.name: on
props.about: What the car sits on, so its edge stands out: bg for the screen background, surface for a card.

props.name: track
props.about: Which circuit to draw, by its country and the year the layout was first used, such as gb-1948 for Silverstone.

props.name: marker
props.about: How each car is drawn: a plain dot, the driver's code, or the car number.

props.name: labels
props.about: Which cars get a name tag: none, the leader, the top 3, cars close to each other in a battle, or all.

props.name: moments
props.about: tags pins race moments such as overtakes and pit stops to the track; off hides them.

props.name: race_control
props.about: Shows the race director's latest message over the circuit.

props.name: orientation
props.about: broadcast turns the track the way TV shows it; north puts north at the top.

props.name: lite
props.about: A lighter way of drawing for smaller panels: cars step instead of gliding. auto picks it on the smaller panel, on and off force it.

props.name: sim
props.about: For previews only: runs a made-up race so the cars move.

props.name: speed
props.about: For previews only: how fast the made-up race runs, real time or 10 or 60 times faster.

props.name: jump
props.about: For previews only: skips the made-up race to a moment such as a safety car or the last lap.

props.name: seed
props.about: For previews only: picks a different made-up race; the same number always gives the same race.

props.name: cars
props.about: For previews only: how many cars are in the made-up race.

props.name: width
props.about: How wide the drawing is, in pixels.

props.name: height
props.about: How tall the drawing is, in pixels.

props.name: feed
props.about: The live race data sent to the panel. Leave empty to use the made-up race.

props.name: flag
props.about: Which flag to show: green, yellow, double_yellow, red, blue, bw (black and white for a warning), black, chequered, sc for the safety car, vsc for the virtual safety car, or none.

props.name: size
props.about: sm is a small flag for a line of text; lg is a big one for a card.

props.name: lines
props.about: How many of the latest messages are shown at once.

props.name: width
props.about: How wide the message list is, in pixels.

props.name: sim
props.about: For previews only: runs a made-up race so messages arrive.

props.name: speed
props.about: For previews only: how fast the made-up race runs, real time or 10 or 60 times faster.

props.name: jump
props.about: For previews only: skips the made-up race to a moment such as a penalty or a red flag.

props.name: seed
props.about: For previews only: picks a different made-up race; the same number always gives the same race.

props.name: feed
props.about: The live race data sent to the panel. Leave empty to use the made-up race.

props.name: form
props.about: How it is laid out: pill is a small tag, card is a box with more room, banner is a wide strip.

props.name: width
props.about: How wide it is, in pixels.

props.name: sim
props.about: For previews only: runs a made-up race so the status changes.

props.name: speed
props.about: For previews only: how fast the made-up race runs, real time or 10 or 60 times faster.

props.name: jump
props.about: For previews only: skips the made-up race to a moment such as a yellow flag or the chequered flag.

props.name: seed
props.about: For previews only: picks a different made-up race; the same number always gives the same race.

props.name: feed
props.about: The live race data sent to the panel. Leave empty to use the made-up race.

props.name: rows
props.about: How many drivers are listed.

props.name: from
props.about: The position the list starts at, so you can show the middle or the back of the field.

props.name: density
props.about: normal gives each driver a comfortable row; compact fits more rows in the same height.

props.name: stat
props.about: The small fact at the end of each row: badges for fastest lap and pit stops, interval for the gap to the car ahead, or tyre for the tyre in use.

props.name: width
props.about: How wide the list is, in pixels.

props.name: sim
props.about: For previews only: runs a made-up race so the order changes.

props.name: speed
props.about: For previews only: how fast the made-up race runs, real time or 10 or 60 times faster.

props.name: jump
props.about: For previews only: skips the made-up race to a moment such as an overtake or a pit stop.

props.name: seed
props.about: For previews only: picks a different made-up race; the same number always gives the same race.

props.name: track
props.about: For previews only: which circuit the made-up race is run on.

props.name: feed
props.about: The live race data sent to the panel. Leave empty to use the made-up race.

props.name: on
props.about: What the outline goes round: box for a card or tile, button for a button, play for the round play button.

props.name: offset
props.about: The gap between the control and its outline: the usual focus gap, none for no gap, or a small or larger step.

props.name: disabled
props.about: Greys the outline, for a chosen control that cannot be used right now.

props.name: width
props.about: How wide the pitch is, in pixels.

props.name: sim
props.about: For previews only: runs a made-up match so the score and events change.

props.name: speed
props.about: For previews only: how fast the made-up match runs, real time or 10 or 60 times faster.

props.name: jump
props.about: For previews only: skips the made-up match to a moment such as a goal, a card or half time.

props.name: seed
props.about: For previews only: picks a different made-up match; the same number always gives the same match.

props.name: feed
props.about: The live match data sent to the panel. Leave empty to use the made-up match.

props.name: state
props.about: Where the update is: updating (about to install) or failed.

props.name: version
props.about: The version being installed. Empty hides it.

props.name: note
props.about: A line that replaces the default one, such as why it failed.

props.name: pr
props.about: For previews only: which made-up pull request to show. n1 to n3 are ones that need your review; m1 to m3 are your own.

props.name: cols
props.about: How many columns, 1 to 8. Leave it out when min is set.

props.name: min
props.about: Instead of cols: the smallest cell, as an icon size step; the grid fits as many columns as it can, so a bigger screen gets more columns. none uses cols.

props.name: gap
props.about: The space between cells: none, near, group or block (from tight to roomy).

props.name: aspect
props.about: The cell shape: square, wide (16 by 9), or row (as tall as what is inside, for text like stats).

props.name: rows
props.about: At most this many rows; 0 for no limit. A list of items that does not fit shows a last cell with +N for the rest.

props.name: items
props.about: The list to repeat one cell per item: a comma list or a JSON list, usually bound to an entity attribute. Each cell is the node's cell template with $item (or $item.field) filled in; without a template, an icon named by the item.

props.name: empty
props.about: The words shown when the items list is empty.

props.name: outline
props.about: For previews only: outlines and names the cells so you can see where things go.

props.name: align
props.about: Which side the parts line up from: start is the left, end is the right.

props.name: flow
props.about: wrap lays the parts side by side and starts a new line when the row is full; stack puts each part under the last.

props.name: space
props.about: The gap between the parts: none, group for related parts, block for separate blocks, near for parts that belong tightly together.

props.name: sample
props.about: For previews only: how many made-up tiles fill the row. 0 shows the empty layout.

props.name: label
props.about: The screen's name, in the title slot; a long one ends in an ellipsis. A component a screen puts in the title replaces it.

props.name: back
props.about: Shows the back button at the start, to return to the screen before.

props.name: clock
props.about: Shows the time at the end of the row.

props.name: time
props.about: For previews only: a fixed time to show, like 21:42. Leave empty for the real time.

props.name: settings
props.about: Puts the settings button in the end slot, before the time, as on Home.

props.name: sample
props.about: For previews only: fills a slot with real components to see how the row fits them (a screen places its own).

props.name: n
props.about: The big number, such as how many things need you.

props.name: label
props.about: The words next to the number that say what it counts.

props.name: line
props.about: One quieter line with the detail, under the label.

props.name: accent
props.about: Draws the number in the accent colour, for when it matters now.

props.name: role
props.about: hero is the largest number for a screen's main figure; display is a step smaller.

props.name: label_type
props.about: How the words next to the number are written: label in small capitals, or title in larger plain text.

props.name: state
props.about: default shows the number; unavailable shows a dash when the value cannot be read.

props.name: label
props.about: The words on the button, such as Hold to open.

props.name: value
props.about: The action the button sends when the hold completes, such as open.

props.name: width
props.about: fill stretches the button across the space it is in; hug fits it to its words.

props.name: features
props.about: What the device can do, as Home Assistant reports it in its supported features number.

props.name: mask
props.about: The feature this button needs. If the device's features do not include it, the button is hidden. 0 always shows it.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be held; disabled is greyed out and cannot be used.

props.name: style
props.about: The button's shape: play is the large round play and pause button, round is a smaller circle, square has rounded corners.

props.name: icon
props.about: The icon on the button, such as next, previous, play or close.

props.name: state
props.about: How the button looks: default ready to tap, pressed while held, active when it is switched on, active-pressed while the active one is held, disabled when it cannot be used, or unavailable when its device cannot be reached.

props.name: name
props.about: Which icon to show, by its name in the icon set (bulb, door, clear-day ...). Bind it to an entity with a map to change the icon with the entity's state; a name with no icon shows a quiet outlined box.

props.name: step
props.about: How big the icon is, as a size step from small up to hero. Each icon is made for some sizes only, so the icon snaps down to the nearest size it has. Leave it out when fit is cell.

props.name: fit
props.about: step: the size comes from step. cell: inside a grid cell or a layout slot, the icon takes the largest size that fits the cell, leaving a small margin. Use step or cell, not both.

props.name: tone
props.about: The icon's colour by what it means: ink for normal, dim for quiet, accent for the screen's colour, ok, warn, error or info for a status.

props.name: src
props.about: The picture's web address (http or https). Bind it to an entity's state or attribute to follow it; in a grid's item cell, $item.field takes it from each item.

props.name: step
props.about: How wide the picture is, as a size step from icon up to hero, or content for the full content width. Leave it out when fit is cell.

props.name: fit
props.about: step: the size comes from step and aspect. cell: inside a grid cell or a layout slot, the picture fills the cell. Use step or cell, not both.

props.name: aspect
props.about: The box shape with step: 1:1, 4:3, 3:2 or 16:9 (width to height).

props.name: scale
props.about: cover fills the box and crops the edges, contain shows the whole picture inside the box, pixel zooms pixel art by whole steps with sharp pixels.

props.name: sampling

props.about: The icon at the start, picked for what the message is about, such as a timer, a person or a washing machine.

props.name: tone
props.about: The icon's colour, by what the message means: ok, warn, error, working, info or idle.

props.name: title
props.about: The message's heading.

props.name: body
props.about: One line of detail under the heading.

props.name: action
props.about: The words of a button on the message, such as Open. Leave empty for no button.

props.name: timer
props.about: Shows a thin bar that runs down until the message goes away on its own.

props.name: life
props.about: How long the message stays: normal, or urgent which stays much longer.

props.name: position
props.about: Where messages appear: from the top or from the bottom of the screen.

props.name: push
props.about: For previews only: the tone of the first sample message that arrives, or none.

props.name: stack
props.about: For previews only: how many sample messages are stacked, up to two showing at once.

props.name: timer
props.about: Shows the bar on each message that runs down until it goes away.

props.name: action
props.about: For previews only: gives the sample messages a button.

props.name: screen
props.about: For previews only: draws a sample screen under the messages.

props.name: on
props.about: Whether the switch is on.

props.name: state
props.about: default can be tapped; disabled cannot be changed; unavailable shows the device cannot be reached.

props.name: mode
props.about: What the robot does: vacuum only, vacuum and mop together, or mop only.

props.name: fan
props.about: How hard it sucks: quiet, balanced, turbo, max or max plus.

props.name: mop
props.about: How much water the mop uses: low, medium or high.

props.name: style
props.about: row shows the settings as a full row; button shows a short button that sits on the map.

props.name: view
props.about: Which vacuum view it sits in: the room list or the map.

props.name: icon
props.about: Which weather to show, such as partly cloudy by day, rain or a clear night.

props.name: size
props.about: How big the icon is drawn, from the small sizes in text up to the hero size of a screen.

props.name: animated
props.about: Makes the icon's parts move gently: rays turn, clouds drift, rain falls. With reduced motion it stays still.

props.name: on
props.about: What the icon sits on, so its colours fit: canvas for the screen background, card for a card.

props.name: view
props.about: Which view to open on: weather with the next hours, sun with sunrise and sunset, moon, or lightning.

props.name: condition
props.about: The weather now, such as rainy. Leave empty to use the forecast.

props.name: temp
props.about: The temperature now. Leave empty to use the forecast.

props.name: feels
props.about: The feels-like temperature. Leave empty to use the forecast.

props.name: place
props.about: The place name shown with the weather. Leave empty for none.

props.name: lat
props.about: Your latitude in degrees, used for sunrise, sunset and the moon.

props.name: lon
props.about: Your longitude in degrees, used for sunrise, sunset and the moon.
